svg.aria-label: North Star architecture: six messy sources pass through adapters with per-source fault boundaries, become Evidence atoms, flow through normalize, identity resolution, merge and confidence scoring on the canonical side; only the canonical record crosses the load-bearing boundary into config-driven projection and validation; every anomaly lands in the run report; one engine serves CLI, local workspace, Docker and an in-browser wasm build
svg.text: multi-source candidate data → one canonical, explainable profile per person · deterministic by construction
every tie breaks toward null + an explanation in the run report
